messages:
Sam: Heads-up — noticed an edge-case where private tenants with egress-disabled get routed to hosted fallback without consent. reproducer below.

Sam: Steps: tenant has control-plane in VPC with egress=false, request originates -> smart-router tries region fallback -> ends up using hosted-api as last resort.

Maya: that's not supposed to happen. Do we have a consent flag check in router? :eyes:

Liam: Router checks tenant.egress_allowed but the ambassador proxy may be translating requests to control-plane which then uses global pool if route fails. Need to short-circuit.

Anita: From product POV we need: (1) explicit deny, (2) audit event, (3) console indicator + rollback path. Can't silently fall back.

Sam: Proposed quick patch: ambassador policy -> if tenant.egress=false then only try local variant chain; if none available return 403 with error_code=PRIVATE_EGRESS_BLOCKED. Example config:

```
"ambassador": {
  "egress_policy": "reject_if_disabled",
  "fallback_chain": ["local_variant","degraded_local"],
  "global_fallback": false
}
```

Liam: +1. Also suggest we emit telemetry: event 'egress.fallback.attempt' with tags {tenant_id, region, attempted_variant, decision} and make it high-cardinality for sampling.

Maya: How about quota/console UX? Ops want a warning in tenant dashboard and a toggle to "allow temporary egress" that leaves an audit trail.

Anita: Yes. UX: banner + button -> creates one-off allow with TTL and reason field. Must create audit entry and billing note.

Riya: If we return 403 for blocked fallbacks, higher-level SDKs need clearer error mapping. We should add a new HTTP header `X-Redwood-Egress-Decision: blocked|allowed|fallback` so clients can auto-detect.

Sam: Good call. Also add guidance in internal API docs and add a rollout flag (engine.flag.private-egress-strict) for canary.

deploy-bot: deploy started for eng-platform/private-egress-guard v2 -> shard-3

Sam: I'll open a PR with config + unit tests. Can someone own telemetry schema and console mockup? @Maya for telemetry, @Anita for console?

Maya: I'll take telemetry. Will sketch event payload and sampling plan today.

Anita: I'll work with design on the TTL UX. placing a note in product board.

Sam: cool — action items: PR, telemetry spec, console mock. We'll gate rollout behind flag and 2-day canary.

Riya: Also add e2e test that simulates onprem control-plane with egress=false and asserts no network call to hosted. I can add.

Sam: thanks all. Filing thread to track. :white_check_mark:
